- **Restart condition** (the body): "the v18 major development cycle opens …, or a maintainer instruction pulls it forward".
- **Scope stands as commissioned** (#9529, Option 1):
  - an AST codemod (`ts-morph`) over `objectstack.config.ts` and the per-artifact authored modules, covering only the mechanical `applied` set;
  - `--write` beside `--out`, with dry-run still the default;
  - the restoration of the shared retirement sentence (`packages/spec/src/shared/retired-key.ts`) rides this PR.
- **Why p3:** authors already get the replay-and-print path. This adds the in-place rewrite it promises.
- `Clause-②: yes` (a new CLI flag). A contract review is owed at the PR.

- `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`: the `os migrate meta` rows gain `--write`.
- **Added at review (PR #22108), amended in place 2026-10-07T17:29Z:** `content/docs/upgrading.mdx` (the flags table, the warn callout and the upgrade-loop comment, all three made false by `--write`). The codemod module is `packages/cli/src/utils/authored-source-codemod.ts`, and the pins are `packages/cli/test/migrate-meta-write.test.ts`. Both `content/docs` pages are declared to `domain:devx` on #20163 (`6043200226`) and #6023 (`6043211160`).
- `.changeset/*.md`: `@objectstack/cli`, with the semver the widening takes.
- **⛔ Not in this claim: the retirement sentence's restoration** (`packages/spec/src/shared/retired-key.ts` and the class-wide pin `retired-key-migrate-sentence.test.ts`). The card body and triage put it in this PR, but `packages/spec` always belongs to the `domain:spec` seat, whoever needs it (`references/lanes/cli.md:12`, `lanes/spec.md:12`, `seat-lifecycle.md:47`). The pin also spans every tombstone sentence in the spec. Until the restoration lands, the current sentence ("list the mechanical edits …; apply them by hand") stays true; it only undersells `--write`. So the PR carries `Refs #9591`, not `Fixes`. At landing the seat releases this card with a `Release:` line and `pm:retriage`, naming the sentence half for the spec lane.
- ⛔ `--stored` / `--apply` (the `sys_metadata` row rewrite) are untouched. ⛔ No `packages/spec` path. ⛔ No new conversion and no change to the chain. (Stop on breach and explain in the report.)
Container & model: `L`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default (opus)`. `dispatch-gates --tier` over the path gives no path-derived mandate. The contract review is owed at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, run by an independent subagent.
Clause-②: yes
- Widening: a new CLI flag (`--write`) that writes authored source files (triage `6038918699`).
Responsibility: `n/a — not a defect card`
